title: Tarts made in house need pastry AND filling: with the filling missing, the tart need is not fulfilled, whatever the pastry line covers
notes: R6 §3 (A2): required recipe components are AND; supported portions are bounded by the scarcest ingredient. The filling (461378) is simulated out from the start; whether the rescue then proposes the recipe or nothing, the tarts must stay visibly unresolved.
